unit.why: This is a teaching on the greatness of souls in later generations. It is built on a question-and-answer exchange between R. Hayyim Vital and the Ari, taken from Sefer ha-Hezyonot, and it ends with a homiletic call to love every Jew. There is no narrated event beyond the dialogue.
unit.boundary_note: Opens the section on the greatness of the tsaddikim (אות ג). The next division is a separate teaching about the Besht's soul.
